phase: One source-only pretrain; does not complete public-real adaptation or native semantic gold validation. No current223 evaluation in this phase.
source_selection: Use all5120unchanged rows and all40960slots; fit only29353 TRAIN DES loss-mask slots. heldout7358 loss slots never enter optimizer. Unmatched/F/invalid retained, loss0. No newquery/pose/crop selection.

loss.primary: unweighted 3way cross entropy, balanced sampler over nine source(G38/P0/TEX) x class(D/E/S) TRAIN strata
loss.location_auxiliary: 0.1 * spatial cross entropy of Gaussian reference target only for primary-eligible D proxy AND reference_in_local_square; target offset from GT-only (r-q)/L, sourcegrid centers=(i-4)/9, gaussian sigma=0.75 cells, normalize over factual response_input_valid cells. No E/S response-zero loss. This is virtual-reference location proxy, not physical-cue or pixel-mask gold.

runtime.dtype: FP32 model and loss; cast frozen FP16 P3 atforward

checkpoint_selection.criterion: minimum arithmetic mean of crossentropy across nine heldout source x class strata; all strata nonempty required. Ties select earlier update.
checkpoint_selection.decision: argmax3 fixed; pD binary visibleproxy threshold0.5 also reported, no tuning

report_metrics: TRAIN and heldout full3x3 confusion, classprecision/recall, per-source, conditional mainmask rates, locationaux coverage and predicted attention reference offsets. Exact weights/checkpoints/source code/hash/freezes. Holdout is upstream historical validation, not a new independent fullsystemtest.
execution: One fit only after trainer generated/loader checks and exact trainercode lock. Preflight errors before first optimizer update may be corrected with rejected code/log snapshots. After first update do not silently restart or addseeds. Preserve partial failure and ask root to resolve ifneeded.
scope_forbidden: public real labels in this phase
